coverImageAlt: A brass drafting compass projects a cyan architectural framework from a blank open folio.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: Architecture prompting represented by a precision drafting compass that projects a coherent structural framework outward from a single blank folded plan.
Scene/backdrop: A restrained slate drafting surface with a warm paper backdrop and ample quiet space.
Subject: One oversized brass-and-navy compass, a pristine unmarked folded sheet, and a cyan wire-like building framework rising from the compass point.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; one crop-safe compass-and-framework silhouette; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: deliberate, generative, quietly technical
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: blank unmarked paper and no measurement markings; completely original image; no input or reference images; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, watermark, product UI, vendor branding, Microsoft Fluent styling, paw imagery, paw logo, cats, or cat silhouettes
